title: Paloma and the Visitor
author: Ines Eriksen
blurb: Ada Galloway, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
